description: Average purchase price (KRW) per holder for one stock. Uses the acquisition prices in the detailed-change section of original 5% large-holding reports: buys add to the weighted average, sells only reduce the quantity (moving average), and stock splits and reverse splits are adjusted. Insider reports carry no price and are not used. holder (part of a filer name) limits to that holder; otherwise all holders with price data. Each row has avg_cost, held_shares (current holding), priced_shares (bought shares that carry a price), coverage_pct, buys, first_trade and last_trade. basis reported means at least half of the current holding has prices; partial means only some (see coverage_pct); unavailable means no prices (the National Pension Service and foreign funds file simplified reports that legally omit prices). When partial, do not state 'average cost is X won' as fact. 한 종목의 보유자별 평균 매입단가(원). 5% 대량보유 보고서 원문의 세부변동내역에 적힌 취득 단가로 매수는 가중평균에 더하고 매도는 수량만 줄이는 이동평균을 내며, 액면분할·병합은 보정한다. 임원·주요주주 보고에는 단가가 없어 쓰지 않는다. holder(보고자명 일부)를 주면 그 보유자만, 없으면 단가가 있는 보유자 전부. 행마다 avg_cost, held_shares(현재 보유), priced_shares(단가가 붙은 매수 주식), coverage_pct, buys, first_trade·last_trade를 준다. basis가 reported면 현재 보유분의 절반 이상에 단가가 있고, partial이면 일부만(coverage_pct 참고), unavailable이면 단가가 없다(국민연금·외국계 약식 보고는 법적으로 단가 생략). partial일 때 '평단 X원'이라고 단정하지 말 것.
